messages:
olivia (product): Quick internal heads-up: we'll publish the official SDK/docs deprecation playbook for the older sync bindings tomorrow. This thread is for any last-minute callouts before we go live. :loudspeaker:

ray (eng): thanks — two asks: include a small compatibility table for supported runtimes + quant formats, and note how Dedicated/private customers can request an extension.

olivia (product): Good points. Plan: compatibility table in the RFC, extension request flow in the FAQ, and a short line in the migration checklist.

maya (docs): Banner copy draft: "Notice: legacy sync SDKs scheduled for migration. Follow the migration playbook for step-by-step instructions and tools." We'll add a before/after code snippet and a link to the codemods repo.

tony (sre): We'll enable the legacy-usage scanner and publish a weekly dashboard to owners. Also adding CI lint rule as opt-in first, enforcement after 6 months.

frank (devex): Shipping plan for tooling: 30-day beta for codemods + compat shim (feature-flagged). We'll publish a small example GH Action and a pip/npm shim package.

ray (eng): Make the shim kill-switchable via env var + org feature flag. Some partners want a predictable rollback.

frank (devex): Agreed — REDWOOD_LEGACY_SHIM=off by default, org opt-in and server-side kill switch. Documented in README.

maya (docs): Action items: publish playbook + banner (tomorrow), migration checklist page (48h), codemod walkthrough (14 days). I'll ping once pages are live for a short all-eng blurb.

olivia (product): Comms plan: internal announcement + customer FAQ + two office hours. Draft customer subject: "Scheduled migration: SDK update and recommended actions" (legal reviewed).

comms-bot: Draft pages created: /docs/announcements/sdk-sync-migration-playbook and /docs/migration/quick-checklist (draft).

olivia (product): Thanks all. If there are any blockers please add them here now — otherwise we'll proceed with the publish tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
